the Philippines|congressional district]] in the province of [[Lanao del Norte]] that has been used in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 5, 2021}} The district's boundaries have only been redrawn once, originally consisting of fifteen southern and interior municipalities, three of which bordered [[Panguil Bay]] and [[Moro Gulf]], which were reduced to eleven municipalities following a reapportionment in November 2009.{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=March 5, 2021}}{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=9774|url=https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9774_2009.html |title=An Act Providing for the Reapportionment of Legislative Districts in the Province of Lanao Del Norte |publisher=The Lawphil Project - Arellano Law Foundation, Inc.|date=November 17, 2009|accessdate=March 5, 2021}} The district is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Aminah Dimaporo|Sittie Aminah Q.
